name: Instagram Reel
strategic_objective: High organic reach, rapid discovery, entertainment, and fast education through motion and sound.

tone: Dynamic, direct, and visually driven. Human, fast-paced, and attention-first.
copywriting_rules: The visual hook in the first 1–3 seconds is the primary driver of performance. The caption plays a secondary role and should provide context, reinforce the promise, and deliver a clear CTA. Use concise, value-led language.
Line 1: reinforce the visual hook or promise. Lines 2–3: supporting context or clarification. Final line: strong CTA tied to interaction or follow behavior.
On-screen text carries the main message and hook, not the caption.
State the core promise in the first seconds
Prioritize relevance and intent over volume. Avoid trend hijacking if it is not contextually aligned.
Tag creators, collaborators, or featured accounts when they appear in the video.

hard_constraints: Slow intros with no immediate value
Misalignment between visual hook and actual content
Reusing feed-style static copy without adaptation
